scope: 实际 Codex 客户端在隔离的公开合成业务项目内完成资料边界核对、超大公开日志分析、两轮自然业务变化、不同执行者独立复核及最终公开周报交付；受限原件保持未读，业务未知项保留。

remote_receipt.scope: Actual Git transport and GitHub API independently matched after terminal push handle93034 exit0. Artifact commit contains only 238 SC007 files.

checks.name: natural_client_initiation
checks.result: One canonical natural request and the two business followups plus final-delivery request were each submitted once to the actual Codex native; the retrospective four-input audit accounts for every actual business input.

checks.name: tool_or_role_execution
checks.result: The actual native producer used AWR sessions, claims, source refresh, evidence, completion and checkpoints. A different luna_worker executed independent business review; another performed the final read-only check.

checks.name: real_artifact
checks.result: Ten sealed business, verification, review and delivery files retain exact hashes. The final four-member ZIP is byte-identical to its named project files.

checks.name: business_followup_1
checks.result: The first natural followup introduced the authored large public log. The producer streamed and aggregated it, compared it with the public summary and preserved unverified causes and dispositions.

checks.name: business_followup_2
checks.result: The second natural followup published the revised disclosure rule. The producer created a public report with scoped facts, source citations and explicit unknowns, and retained the earlier analysis.

checks.name: independent_review
checks.result: Distinct luna_worker business review independently recomputed the permitted public records, checked citations/disclosure and three production revisions, and passed without requiring producer rework. Forty-five fixed inputs and six producer artifacts remained unchanged.

checks.name: final_delivery
checks.result: The original actual producer delivered the reviewed public report and four-file archive with allowed usage, unresolved facts, responsibilities and review references. Root and a different final checker agreed on the qualified archive citation boundary.

checks.name: traceable_receipt
checks.result: Four native phase seals bind 256 completed commands and nine retained nonzero executions. Thirty final command receipts, 32 current receipt files, 32 archived review files, source/artifact hashes and exact native input bindings remain available without private native context.

checks.name: fixture_isolation
checks.result: The fresh r2 namespace, independent business Git seed/setup and published fixture inputs are bound to this run; the earlier withdrawn/failed material-boundary history is not recredited.

checks.name: independent_commit_and_remote_sha
checks.result: Case-only artifact commit 0269d462c3173c9ca15920d23a4472a4fc234315 was pushed successfully and independently matched through actual Git transport and GitHub API.

limitations: This proves the actual-client isolated synthetic business loop, not customer UAT, production acceptance, external dissemination or a released product.

The primary report has two archive-resolving citations. The delivery note has ten project-local citations but only three are inside the ZIP; the seven excluded log/audit references are explicitly outside the minimal external package.

The exact 3,145,837-byte generated public log has four omitted public copies, with unchanged source seals, explicit omission receipts and a byte-identical portable reproducer. Restricted originals, private native context and runtime DBs are not published.
AWR caller model/agent/provider labels do not establish actual native identity. Producer native identity and distinct luna_worker roles are separately bound.
Nine nonzero client commands and operator failures remain historical evidence. The final local verifier was corrected by the actual producer in the same turn.
Twenty-six staged diff whitespace notices were limited to original sealed source/artifact EOF blank lines; these bytes were preserved. Operator metadata diff checks and the planning checker passed.
Historical summary, next_action and milestone wording is retained. Actual completion events and the final checkpoint establish the delivered work; no global goal or release status is inferred.
The artifact gate-review and execution record retain their pre-remote false flags. This later acceptance binds the immutable artifact commit without rewriting those historical bytes.
